analysis.title: US Equities Mid-Day Color
key_insights: Markets are firmly lower on 10/30 (RTY > SPX > NDX in size of decline) as weak tech earnings from the prior night weigh on sentiment. SPX ex AI (SPXXAI Index) is +35bps, and about 55% of S&P names trade lower.
WTI crude is up 2.5% following reports of attacks on tankers in the Strait of Hormuz.
Disappointing tech earnings the prior night: INTC -30% (its worst intraday move on record), AMZN -2.3% after being down 12% intraday, SNDK -12.9%.

GS baskets: Momentum (GSPRHIMO) -4.5%, Hyperscalers (GSXUHYPR) -2.1%, Neoclouds (GSXUNEOC) -10.2%, Broad AI (GSTMTAIP) -5.8%. After sizable supply in the morning, the GS TMT pad saw demand in INTC and AMZN.
Bitcoin Sensitive basket (GSCBBTC1) is -8.7% after hackers stole $6.3bn from Binance.

Defensive rotation: the Cyclicals vs Defensives pair (GSP1CYDE) is -2.6%, driven by strength on the defensives leg. Bond Proxies (GSXUBOND) are +1.5%. Staples (XLP) are +1.6% on earnings (MDLZ +3.7%, CL +3.4%, CHD +1.8%).

Month-end: GS expects elevated closing auction volumes in S&P index stocks. It is also fiscal year end for many, and the tax loss selling basket (GSCBMF22) is -6.9%. US pensions are modeled to buy $4.5bn of equities, the 31st percentile of buy and sell estimates in dollar value over the past three years. The prior day's $9bn buy-on-close imbalance looked like a pre-trade for these dynamics.

GS desk flows: the TMT buying from earlier in the week has been fully reversed. The desk had net bought $5bn of TMT before Thursday, after selling $20bn over the prior two weeks, and that figure is now unchanged. Today the desk has net sold $2.5bn notional of information tech.

Desk activity is 6 out of 10, with overall franchise flows skewed 8% better for sale. Long-only clients are skewed 20% better for sale (supply in industrials, information tech, consumer discretionary). Hedge funds are skewed 7% better for sale (supply in industrials and information tech, notable demand in macro products).
Chart of the Day: on 10/29, 80% of SPX members closed green while the SPX itself closed down 30bps.

AMZN reported 10/29 after the close and was down 12% at the low, then -2.3% at the time of writing. No EPS or revenue figures are given.
SNDK reported 10/29 after the close and was -12.9% on 10/30. No EPS or revenue figures are given.
MDLZ (+3.7%), CL (+3.4%) and CHD (+1.8%) reported decent earnings on the morning of 10/30. No figures are given.
